speedMapping.status: Bounded constant ratio mapping established statically; enabled curve mappings remain unestablished.
speedMapping.gate: Use this ratio branch only when absence of native enabled offset mapping is established. Missing, unreadable or unsupported parameter mapping must not fall back to ratio.

definitions.reverse: serialized numerator and denominator have different signs; native stores sign XOR

speedMapping.ratioMeaning: Mapping multiplier is D/N, not N/D. This is native constant mapping; enabled curve may override it.

fields.offsetAdjust: Stored atobject+0x140. The pure-ratio mapping does not read it. GetOffsetMappingAdjustment uses it for non-graph-enabled mapping; not enough to invent curve semantics.
fields.newSourceCalculation: Stored booleanat0x15c, returnedby HasNewSourceCalculation. Pure-ratio MapOffsetDown/MapRangeDown do not query it. Other source recalculation paths are not audited.
fields.graphEnabled: _MFX_GRAPH_ENABLED attribute; native GetParamClipEnabled returns default1 ifabsent.
fields.sourceParamList: Separate MotionEffect.source_param_list; nonempty/relevant vector-edit source relationship not audited.

unsupportedCases: Enabled offset/speed map effect interpolation and extrema, including reverse or nonmonotonic curves.
Nonempty or unreadable parameter/source-param list whose active mapping cannot be classified.
Arbitrary effect behavior, unknown render/deinterlace mapping, nonlinear or unsupported parameter controls.
Mixed-rate conversion outside this local mapping, malformedzero ratio, overflow/invalidbounds.
No universal N/D fallback for genuine SPED because all5sampledSPED have enabled curve records.
speedMapping.genuineQualification: All5 genuine SPED samples have speed/offset ParamItems with enabled controls and new_source_calculation=true. They are not pureconstant-ratio acceptance samples even when their speed_ratio looks simple. Phase0/33/75; alloffsetadjust0; graphenabledattributeabsent defaults1.

representationSetFinding.established: RSET range conversion itself is identity, but native GetTValue and GetPrecomputeRange select one representation. Default ChooseOne returns0 only for exactlyone track, otherwise-1. RSET inherits broad VisitCompsSubrange, so inherited visitation must not be treated as proof all representations are used.
representationSetFinding.safeBoundedPolicy: A single fully established RSET child can use identity timing. Multiple choices need an established choice; absent that, mark branch incomplete rather than emit all alternative representations.
representationSetFinding.limits: No runtimeMediaComposer choice or externallycached representation preference was established; no claim every RSET type behavesidentically throughallcallers.
